    43   */
    44  #define TABLE_TYPE_STR_FUNC(_func, _our_table_type, _our_name, _our_def_type, _our_return_type) \
    45  _our_return_type _our_name(_our_table_type table, size_t table_len, char const *name, _our_def_type def) \
    46  { \
    47          _our_return_type ret; \
    48          _our_table_type found; \
    49          found = (_our_table_type)_func(table, table_len, sizeof(((_our_table_type)0)[0]), name); \
    50          if (!found) { \
    51                  memcpy(&ret, &def, sizeof(ret)); \
    52                  return ret; \
    53          } \
    54          memcpy(&ret, &found->value, sizeof(ret)); \
    55          return ret; \
    56  }
